652:t_1:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It seems the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ was transferred to the opposite side of the galactic center from us.」

652:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Did you make contact with them?」

652:t_1:6.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Apparently we could only communicate for a limited time, though.」

652:t_1:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So they're under attack from $$ミケーネ$$ and the $$御使い$$s over there too?」

652:t_1:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「In that transmission, they said they were being attacked by the $$バジュラ$$... and specifically the type controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

652:t_1:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s $$バジュラ$$...」

652:t_1:10.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「A super long-range emigrant fleet, just like the $$フロンティア船団$$ and the $$マクロス７船団$$... It seems they're somewhere near the galactic center too.」

652:t_1:11.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But to attack the $$クォーター$$ right out of the gate...」

652:t_1:12.en:
$$ファ$$
「Does that mean they have a complete grasp of our movements, in this whole wide universe...?」

652:t_1:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't tell that far. But the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s movements need watching.」

652:t_1:14.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's strange, isn't it... We managed to join hands even with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and yet humans are still fighting each other...」

652:t_1:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「I heard something from $$シェリル$$ once.」

652:t_1:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「She said the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has places that actively promote 《$$インプラント$$》 technology, and that it's not normal, somehow...」

652:t_1:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Their sense of ethics and morality may be completely different from ours...」

652:t_1:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ランカ$$ and the others tried to communicate with the $$バジュラ$$ through the fold waves in their songs...」

652:t_1:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is controlling them by some means.」

652:t_1:20.en:
$$キラ$$
「Coexistence and domination are different... If they go about it that way, the fighting will never end...」

652:t_1:21.en:
$$シン$$
「It'll be okay, $$キラ$$. $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are over there... and $$バサラ$$ too.」

652:t_1:22.en:
$$アスラン$$
「The power of their songs will put an end to the fighting with the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s ambitions.」

652:t_1:23.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah... I believe we'll meet everyone at the galactic center, for sure.」

652:t_1:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-Yes! Sorry, Big Sis... I mean, $$ノリコ$$!」

652:t_1:32.en:
$$セイミー$$
「Come on, get to work! It's a total war for humanity, so everyone who can move helps with maintenance!」

652:t_1:33.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Even so, that's overdoing it... Ever since we got here it's been one attack after another from the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, and we haven't had a moment to rest, you know.」

652:t_1:34.en:
$$くらら$$
「Stop complaining. We're all just as tired.」

652:t_1:35.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Besides, even at this very moment the countdown to Earth's last day keeps going.」

652:t_1:36.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「By then we have to wipe out the $$バアル$$ completely, and on top of that defeat the evil gods and the $$御使い$$s.」

652:t_1:37.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Just the fact that you two aren't flirting raises the seriousness level...」

652:t_1:38.en:
$$葵$$
「So that's how it is, $$ノノ$$... If you slack off, I'll be hard on you in place of $$ラルク$$.」

652:t_1:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Bring it on, $$葵$$! With hard work and guts, $$ノノ$$ will do it too!」

652:t_1:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is spinning her wheels...」

652:t_1:41.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She really does seem to be worried about $$ラルク$$, after all...」

652:t_1:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are both $$バスターマシン$$ riders, even if they're from different worlds... They try too hard with their hard work and guts.」

652:t_1:44.en:
$$朔哉$$
「$$ノノ$$ is one thing, but $$ラルク$$ and hard work and guts...?」

652:t_1:46.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But wouldn't you say someone with no hard work or guts couldn't be an ace, or come up with that $$雷王星$$ drop of hers?」

652:t_1:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「As expected of the Queen of Roses... You don't let needless preconceptions fool you, and you see the Princess very well.」

652:t_1:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... everyone's version of hard work and guts is different.」

652:t_1:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Some guys, like $n, are at simulations and special training all year round, and others, like $$ラルク$$, keep it hidden.」

652:t_1:51.en:
$n
「I knew about it. She... always joined my training, acting like she had no choice.」

652:t_1:52.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Right, right. And when we were done, she'd give me advice, all smug and snide, like she was doing me a huge favor.」

652:t_1:53.en:
$$マリ$$
「In short, any girl they call 'Princess' has the same attribute, nya~.」

652:t_1:54.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You stay out of this, Four-Eyes.」

652:t_1:57.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone knows a Big Sis that $$ノノ$$ doesn't know...」

652:t_1:58.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Princess changed before anyone noticed.」

652:t_1:59.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's not only the Princess who changed, though.」

652:t_1:60.en:
$$チコ$$
「And the ones who changed the Princess are you, $$ノノ$$... and $c.」

652:t_1:62.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right. And then, of course, there's $$ノリコ$$'s presence.」

652:t_1:63.en:
$n
「So your hard work and guts, you two, influenced $$ラルク$$ too?」

652:t_1:64.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis said... she hates that kind of thing...」

652:t_1:65.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Hard work and guts... Nobody likes pain and suffering.」

652:t_1:66.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But you know, $$ノノ$$... Both $$ノリコ$$ and $$ラルク$$ know it.」

652:t_1:67.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That you can't do anything without hard work and guts.」

652:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ is worried... It's like Big Sis is being driven by something...」

652:t_1:71.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... I feel like, if this keeps up, someday... a day will come when Big Sis stops taking care of herself...」

652:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

652:t_1:77.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any funny ideas.」

652:t_1:79.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time when everyone feels they have to do that...」

652:t_1:80.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

652:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you might be stuck over the whole $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$ business...」

652:t_1:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially one younger than me.」
